author: Mrpotatohead69
quote:
I was looking forward to this game for years, which makes it especially unfortunate just how much of a disappointment it turned out to be. Where do I begin. Explosions look straight out of Bollywood, a 747 crashes into a building, bounces off, then explodes eventually, but the entire body remains in tact, just the wings fall off. What a joke. Boats, a key feature of Florida life, have no downstairs / cabin area built (these could’ve been amazing safe houses). There’s incredible attention to detail in the strangest of places, but then not in a lot of the places it really matters. Seems like the building of GTA 6 was not very cohesive.

The story is the worst bit though, so dry and boring, an obvious attempt to avoid offending as many people as possible (especially the ultra sensitive groups). GTA 5 was so popular because it was so fun, so light. GTA 6 is serious and too much of a real life simulator, designed for people who seem to have no life and seek a relationship simulator.
